ValidationRule.description: Shipping Street address can only be one line
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: NOT ( OR ( REGEX(ShippingStreet, "(.){0,20}"), REGEX(ShippingStreet, "(.){0,20}\r\n(.){0,20}"), REGEX(ShippingStreet, "(.){0,20}\n(.){0,20}"), REGEX(ShippingStreet, "(.){0,20}\r(.){0,20}") ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Shipping Street must be one line.
